start.name_en: Sinopec Guangxi Phase-3 LNG Receiving Terminal (start of the project's south loop network segment, 2m outside its wall)
start.geocode_source: No OSM/Overpass feature found for '中石化广西LNG接收站' or 'Sinopec'+'LNG' within a Tieshan Port District bounding box (21.27-21.68N, 109.30-109.62E) — LNG terminal is not individually mapped in OSM. Anchored to Nominatim '铁山港区' -> OSM relation 3241956 administrative-boundary centroid as a district-level fallback.

end.name_en: Xinggang Distribution Station (end of the south loop network segment)
end.geocode_source: Nominatim query '兴港' bounded to Tieshan Port District -> OSM node 5133273338 '兴港镇' (Xinggang Town), 铁山港区, 北海市 — town centroid, matches the distribution station's name; not a station-level fix.

corridor_notes: SPECIAL NOTE: this is a branching network, not a single point-to-point line — the project's own safety-evaluation registry entry (hnocse.com) describes TWO pipe segments under one project name ('广西天然气支线管网项目铁山港天然气支线管道工程'): (1) a 3.14km 'gas-source connector line' (气源联络线) from 2m outside the wall of Guangxi Pipeline's Beihai First Station (广西管道北海首站) to this project's #1 valve chamber (1#阀室); and (2) a 25.89km 'south loop network' (南部环网管道) from 2m outside the wall of Sinopec's Guangxi Phase-3 LNG receiving station (中石化广西三期LNG接收站) through the #1 valve chamber, Tieshan Port first station (铁山港首站), and Nanzhuwan distribution station (南珠湾分输站), terminating at Xinggang distribution station (兴港分输站). Combined length ~29.0km (close to GEM's recorded 30km). Given the topology, the two anchors chosen for candidate-route purposes are the Sinopec LNG terminal (south-loop start / effective gas source for the loop) and Xinggang distribution station (loop terminus); the gas-source connector to Beihai First Station and the three intermediate stations (#1 valve chamber, Tieshan Port first station, Nanzhuwan distribution station) should be treated as required waypoints/branch points on any drawn route, not skipped as a straight line between the two anchors. Large-diameter (DN800/DN500 per pilot digest), high-pressure (10/6.3 MPa) branch trunk.
researcher_notes: Re-verified hnocse.com, yanshougs.com and the dnr.gxzf.gov.cn Wayback snapshot live this pass (all 200 via url_verifier). hnocse.com is the single best source found for this row: a safety-evaluation-industry registry entry that names the project and gives the exact two-segment route description with all station names (quoted in corridor_notes). Could not geocode the Sinopec LNG terminal, Beihai First Station, #1 valve chamber, Tieshan Port first station, or Nanzhuwan distribution station individually — none appear in OSM/Overpass under these names within the Tieshan Port District bounding box, so the LNG terminal start anchor falls back to the district centroid (coarser than the confirmed town-level fix for Xinggang). No GIS/vector layer found. Per the pilot digest's own cross-check: a separately-reported 'Tieshan East Port gas branch pipeline project' (铁山东港天然气支线管道项目, Feb-2024 equity-acquisition report) that the prior pass flagged as a possible undiscovered THIRD Beihai-area pipeline appears, on this pass's reading of P7665's sourcing, to actually just BE P7665 (Donggang Industrial Park branch) under an alternate name — same operator chain (广投管网公司/天圜能源(广西)有限公司 both named in P7665's own commissioning article) — so that lead is resolved, not a new discovery candidate.
blockers: Sinopec LNG terminal and the three named intermediate stations (#1阀室, 铁山港首站, 南珠湾分输站) could not be individually geocoded — none found in OSM/Overpass by name within the district. Diameter breakdown (800/500/400mm — third value unconfirmed) and SegmentCost discrepancy flagged by the pilot digest remain open and are outside this route-creation task's scope.
